items.title: No school Wednesday
items.text: Your teacher is ill and there is no one to take over. Stay home on Wednesday 7 October.

items.title: Book market
items.text: On Thursday 8 October there is a book market. Bring 2.50 euros, that buys you 3 books.

items.title: Trip to the zoo
items.text: On Friday 9 October your class goes to the zoo. Bring a packed lunch and a raincoat.

items.title: No sweets at school
items.text: Bring fruit or a sandwich for the break, no crisps or sweets.

items.title: Book market
items.text: On Thursday 8 October there is a book market. Bring 2.50 euros, that buys you 3 books.

items.title: Gym on Monday
items.text: Bring your gym clothes and shoes with white soles on Monday.

items.title: Week against bullying
items.text: This week your class talks about being kind to each other and how to say sorry.
